items.title: Paramount delays Warner Bros. merger until June amid lawsuit
items.summary: Investing.com -- Paramount said Friday it agreed to halt its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery until June 1, 2027, or until a federal judge rules on a lawsuit filed by state attorneys general seeking to block the deal.

items.title: Paramount Stock Falls After Agreeing to Delay Warner Bros. Merger
items.summary: According to a court filing from Friday, the companies have agreed to pause the transaction until five days after the court issues a final decision on the merger, or until June 1, 2027.

Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) after agreeing to end its film distribution joint venture with Universal Pictures.
